versions.subject: rules: bitsadmin coverage
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\bitsadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /transfer '
        - ' /create '
        - ' /addfile '
selection_folder:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
        - '%temp%'
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        - '%ProgramData%'
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '%AppData%'
condition: all of selection*

versions.subject: feat: add missing `OriginalFileName` field
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\bitsadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'bitsadmin.exe'
selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /transfer '
        - ' /create '
        - ' /addfile '
selection_folder:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
        - '%temp%'
        - '%tmp%'
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        - '%ProgramData%'
        - '\AppData\Local\'
        - '%AppData%'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\bitsadmin.exe" OR OriginalFileName="bitsadmin.exe" CommandLine IN ("* /transfer *", "* /create *", "* /addfile *") CommandLine IN ("*C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*%temp%*", "*%tmp%*", "*C:\\ProgramData\\*", "*%ProgramData%*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\*", "*%AppData%*")
